commitments.required_outcome_proof: Inspect the meaning-first approval synopsis and prove generated full-contract requirements retain the exact approved Intent and stable OC1-OC7 commitments.
commitments.user_visible_consequence: The owner sees and approves the requested outcome itself before detailed requirements can narrow it.

commitments.required_outcome_proof: Trace every material capability through sourced coverage, semantic classifications, lifecycle enforcement, outcome evidence and adversarial QA.
commitments.user_visible_consequence: Source intent, capability coverage, narrowing decisions and outcome proof remain inspectable across the whole workflow.

commitments.required_outcome_proof: Run a realistic disposable workflow and current dogfood journey where a green-but-wrong proxy is rejected before closeout.
commitments.user_visible_consequence: An implementation cannot pass by proving a related canary while leaving the requested normal job impossible.

commitments.required_outcome_proof: Present internally consistent downstream artifacts whose proxy outcome is still rejected by audit, QA and behavioural evaluation.
commitments.user_visible_consequence: Green documents, tests and hashes cannot conceal that the owner still cannot do the requested job.

commitments.required_outcome_proof: Verify bounded Fix proportionality, gold-plating avoidance, sanitized fixtures and package compatibility without claiming perfect semantic certainty.
commitments.user_visible_consequence: The stronger controls remain proportionate and do not turn bounded work into maximal scope or repeated ceremony.

commitments.required_outcome_proof: Keep semantic classifications sourced and reviewable while deterministic checks enforce identity, coverage, freshness and lifecycle state.
commitments.user_visible_consequence: The workflow exposes judgment and uncertainty instead of laundering a semantic confidence score into truth.

commitments.required_outcome_proof: Retain the owner-approved parent requirements identity and sourced child mappings through package and self-hosted parity checks.
commitments.user_visible_consequence: Every downstream claim remains subordinate to the exact owner-approved Intent rather than to agent-authored IDs alone.

review_source: Fresh sourced mapping review against the owner-approved parent Intent, Epic contract, decomposition and all child plans after the complete package-parity and inspectable-dogfood remediation.
